description: Output-contract evals: every case holds structured assertions over the artifact a flagship skill must produce. The runner (scripts/output-eval.mjs) checks structure, required sections, and format invariants; it cannot judge content quality, only that the contract the skill promises is actually deliverable. Extend by adding a fixture artifact plus assertions per skill.

invariants.tickets_are_slices: every ticket names user-visible capability and layers; none is a pure layer task unless Slice scope says why
invariants.blocking_edges_declared: every ticket carries Blocked by (or none) and edges form no cycle
invariants.validation_commands_present: every step carries an executable VALIDATE command

invariants.ac_identifiers: every acceptance criterion carries a stable AC-N identifier
invariants.non_goals_present: explicit out-of-scope list exists (empty section is a failure)

invariants.mvp_segregated: P0/MVP items are separated from P1/P2 future phases
invariants.metrics_quantified: success metrics carry numbers or thresholds, not adjectives
